sanskrit: śaktyā vimarśavapuṣā svātmano'nanyarūpayā pañcakṛtyamahānāṭyarasikaḥ krīḍati prabhuḥ na viśvaviśvavapuṣorbhinnatā kāpi tāttvikī sattāsphurattāsambandhāt sattābhānaṃ tu tatra cet svarūpalābhasulābhaḥ sambandho nahyavastunaḥ apekṣāyāmavasthānaṃ na syādetasya kiñcana vināśānabhyupagame jaḍatā'pi nivartate tataścidaikyaṃ prakṛtaṃ jagato na nivartate paricchinatti kaḥ śaktiṃ śambhorviśvātiśāyinaḥ yacca kiñcijjagatyasmin prakāśānnātiricyate avadhānaikatānānāṃ matirevātra sākṣiṇī nahi vaikartanaṃ jyotirdīpālokamapekṣate ādarśe vimalābhoge nanu sarvaṃ prakāśate ādau śuddhātmakaṃ tattvaṃ pañcadhā tamasaḥ param akṣādiśāntavarṇātmā niraṇāyi śivena tu māyāpūrvovakārādiyakārāntākṣarātmakaḥ śrotrādipañcakaṃ nādi ṇādi vāgādipañcakam sisṛkṣoḥ prathamaspandaḥ śivatattvaṃ prabhoḥ smṛtam svecchayā racitaṃ viśvamācchādyā'hantayā sthitam tadeveśvaratattvaṃ syāt paśyad viśvamidantayā svāṅgakalpeṣu bhāveṣu māyātattvaṃ vibhedadhīḥ ayameva hi saṃsārī jīvo bhokteti gadyate tatsaṃkocāt saṃkucitāḥ kalādyātmatayā matāḥ vidyā kiñcijjñatāhetū rāgo'bhiṣvaṅgakāraṇam kartavyaṃ nānyadityeṣā vyavasthā yantraṇākṛtiḥ

ahaṃ mamedamityetadbuddhiheturahaṅkṛtiḥ saṃkalpasya vikalpasya bījaṃ mana udīryate kāraṇaṃ śravaṇādīnāṃ grāhyaṃ tanmātrapañcakam parāparāśaktimayaṃ śuddhavidyādipañcakam iyaṃ devī parā śaktiḥ śuddhāśuddhādhvagarbhiṇī tadā kāraṇamātrāṇi bahirudvamate vibhuḥ kriyecchājñānaśaktīnāṃ sattā cocchūnatā ca ṣaṭ catvāraḥ parato varṇāḥ ṣaṇḍhātmānaḥ pracoditāḥ trikoṇamatha ṣaṭkoṇamicchāyāṃ rūḍhimāgate tathaivonmeṣayogena kriyāśakteḥ sphuṭaṃ vapuḥ parasparā virodhena kāryeṣu prasare gate bindurvedyasya saṃskāro vimarśaḥ sarga ityasau tithayaḥ pratipatpūrvāḥ pañcadaśyantimā yathā tathā vimarśavapuṣaḥ sargasyādyāḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ nityapravṛttā śṛṅgāṭavapurviśvasya janmabhūḥ baṭabīje yathā vṛkṣastathātra nihitaṃ jagat mṛdādeḥ kalaśādīnāṃ tattvaṃ nānyannirūpaṇe iha sarvaṃ sadevāgra āsīditi viniścayāt viluptapratyayākāramevaitat pariśiṣyate śaktiśūle vilīyante caturdaśakalātmani itthaṃ parasyāṃ saṃvittau sarvaṃ saṃkucitaṃ kramāt viśvātmani mahāmantrasvabhāve sā vilīyate sarvaṃ haviridaṃ juhvanna dāridryeṇa pīḍyate saṃkocayan parāmarśāt sāmānyaspandakevalaḥ parākramaparo bhuṅkte svabhāvamaśivāpaham
vimṛśata janāḥ kiṃ no bhūyaḥ svabhāvavijṛmbhitam
